Low evening sun rakes the whole length of the house almost level, so the hazed air goes hot apricot while the ribs and the wet iron underfoot stay slate-blue. Palette: apricot against slate-blue.

The light comes down through layer after layer of leaf-shaded glass and the whole interior swims in jade and bottle-green, with one bright lemon-yellow patch on the wet grating where a pane is bare. Palette: jade and lemon-yellow.

Dusk, and the gas mantles are lit: warm amber glowing in a row along the catwalk and the beds beneath them, the panes overhead gone deep peacock-blue with the last of the sky. Palette: amber against peacock-blue.

A storm is running down the glass. Flat pewter-grey daylight fills everything, the water sheeting on the panes catches a hard silver shine, and the boiler's open firedoor throws one small orange pool onto the wet floor. Palette: pewter-silver against orange.
Full noon straight overhead: the steam in the high air blazes white and the whole house below it goes saturated emerald with deep teal in every shadow. Palette: white and emerald.

First sun, low and rose-gold, comes in almost level and lies in long pools along the wet grating, while the far end of the house is still cold lavender with night. Palette: rose-gold against lavender.

Snow is banked on the outside of the panes and the light through it is soft blue-white like frosted milk; inside, the hot-water pipes glow and light the nearest leaves warm ochre from below. Palette: blue-white against ochre.
Sun comes through the steam in broad soft shafts of dusty gold, strikes the pool, and bounces a shifting turquoise ripple-light up onto the iron ribs overhead. Palette: dusty gold and turquoise.

Late side-light comes in low through the glazed flank so every leaf is honey on one side and cool slate-violet on the other, and the whole house is built out of those two colours. Palette: honey against slate-violet.

Overcast pearl-grey daylight floods in evenly from every direction, and the only colour in the place is the planting itself: acid-green new fronds and one bed of hot scarlet blooms. Palette: pearl-grey with acid-green and scarlet.

Sunset burns at the far end wall and the whole house fills with tangerine haze, the ribs black against it, while a cool mint-green glow leaks in behind from the cold-house through the inner glass. Palette: tangerine against mint-green.
Moonlight and gaslight together: every wet pane above holds silver-blue, and warm brass-amber pools low around the lamps along the bed edges. Palette: silver-blue against brass-amber.

A lamplit night inspection: pools of warm sodium-gold under each hanging lamp, deep bottle-green dark in between, and the steam curling up bright through each lamp's cone of light. Palette: sodium-gold against bottle-green.

Rain has just stopped and the glass above is beaded, breaking the sun into hundreds of soft bright points; the house beneath is washed cool aquamarine with warm russet on the brick floor. Palette: aquamarine against russet.

The shade blinds are half drawn, so the light arrives in broad warm cream where the panes are still clear and cool sage-green where the blind filters it, the two meeting in a soft line across the beds. Palette: cream against sage-green.
Deep viridian shade under the fern tiers, and down through the one open vent comes a single hot shaft of white-gold that lands on the wet stone and steams. Palette: viridian and white-gold.
Low winter sun through frosted glass leaves the whole house pale gold and ivory with lilac shadows, and the steam standing off every pipe joint is lit bright. Palette: pale gold against lilac.

Night at the boiler end: one hot orange glow out of the open firedoor lights the undersides of the leaves and the drifting steam, and everything beyond it lies cool indigo. Palette: orange against indigo.
A heat-haze afternoon, the high air thick and the light gone peach and dusty, while the pool below throws a cool green counter-light up into the roof. Palette: peach against cool green.
The sky has cleared hard and clean after a downpour: sharp cobalt showing through the wet panes and everything inside bright glossy grass-green. Palette: cobalt and grass-green.
A hot copper-pink dawn glows through the end glass and lies flat along the wet nave floor, while the roof overhead is still deep blue-grey. Palette: copper-pink against blue-grey.
Midday comes through leaf and steam all dappled, hundreds of small warm yellow patches shifting on the wet grating and the air above them soft milky white. Palette: warm yellow and milky white.
